verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents splitting incoming payments into Subaccounts, which covers the core marketplace split. It also documents single and bulk transfers to bank accounts, which a platform could use to pay out each seller. Seller onboarding (creating or verifying subaccounts) is only implied, and the evidence is one-line doc mentions. missing for 10: explicit seller onboarding/KYC flow for subaccounts, documentation that split funds settle or pay out to each seller automatically, depth on split rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller

citations.quote: Learn how to split incoming payments into Subaccounts.
Transfer funds to multiple recipients using bulk transfers.
Make single or bulk transfers to bank accounts from your Flutterwave dashboard.
